checks: initial state cannot export nonexistent results
worker runs real scheduling and renders the synthetic comparison
export contains actual scenario hash and modeled flows
CSV includes every requested job and exact chosen slots
editing input invalidates exports and removes the old schedule
invalid battery energy is rejected rather than clamped
tampered saved scenario is rejected without destroying current inputs
import verifies inputs but does not trust a saved optimization result
infeasible model yields no executable plan
untrusted job names remain literal text
narrow layout stays within viewport with scrollable tables
no page errors or unexpected app network requests
limitations: Chromium only; no hardware or independent field validation.
